verdict.rationale: Supermemory is a memory API, so integrating it into real-time voice pipelines is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack contains no documented LiveKit, Pipecat, ElevenLabs, or other voice-pipeline integration, and no latency claims suited to live conversation. General TypeScript/Python SDKs and the MCP server are developer building blocks, not the named voice integrations.

support.subject: As a developer, I can wire memory into real-time voice pipelines (e.g. LiveKit, Pipecat, ElevenLabs) with documented integrations fast enough for live conversation
